correctness.rationale: The frozen proof contains a false coarea equality: the weighted density integral must extend over the whole hyperplane v⊥, not the bounded section O∩v⊥. The integrand is strictly positive outside the bounded section. The repaired proof instead triangulates the hexagon with vertices u,w,z,−u,−w,−z obtained by the six edge crossings. After the opposite triangles cancel the triangle factor of 1/2, the three cross products contribute a/((a+b)(a+c)), c/((a+c)(b+c)), and b/((b+c)(a+b)) to area divided by normal length. Continuity of the section area and the axis diamond supply the missing-coordinate cases. The boundary is the radial level set at one; coordinate-plane strata are covered by continuity. Independent symbolic calculations verify the stated section formula, all signed forms and the Cayley change. The Cayley gradient forces all q_i to solve the same quadratic; checking multiplicities (1,3) and (2,2) and the equal-coordinate case leaves exactly the four coordinate points. Each has nondegenerate quadric tangent cone, and all their images have t≠0. A reducible projective cubic would be singular along a curve or surface, so these are absolutely irreducible. Their signed cubic and quadratic coefficients distinguish them; each has a smooth real octant patch and its Zariski closure is the whole cubic. These arguments certify the repaired claim, not just the finitely checked nodes. The frozen checker was inspected but not executed.
